svg.title: EvidenceMIL system flow
svg.desc: Grid: rows are system layers (dashboard, API, ML core, agent, data), columns are the six pipeline stages (input, tile, encode, aggregate, explain, report).
svg.text: Rows = system layers (folders). Columns = pipeline stages, left to right. One step event per column drives the dashboard animation.
